name: Umi (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Umi town emblem in red and white: a red stylised device of a ring and horizontal strokes outlined in white.
history: Municipal flag of Umi, a town in Fukuoka Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 November 1975.

features.role: Umi town emblem — a red stylised device of a ring and horizontal strokes outlined in white
